{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''bounty hunter''' was hired as part of a group of fellow hunters by a [[Rodian/Sullustan crime syndicate]] to capture a team of [[hunting/Legends|hunters]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] and bring them in alive. Although the group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] failed to capture their marks after an initial skirmish with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[commando/Legends|commandos]], one hunter remained to ambush the agents later on. 

The targets retreated to [[Luxury hunting lodge|their hunting lodge]], resulting to a skirmish with Imperials and an explosion that destroyed the lodge. Descending from the sky via [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] and wielding a [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launcher]], the hunter prepared to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the agents, no longer caring about the part of the contract specifying a live capture, but was soon attacked from behind by a wild [[krak'jya]] beast.<ref name="AMDH">''{{WEGCite|story=A Most Deadly Hunt|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}''</ref>
